decision_delta: Greyhound heavy read-only agent and offline filesystem work advanced from an established unbounded-scan risk to a repository-owned exact-root wrapper that verifies cgroup-v2 physical-read ceilings, defaults to one worker and safe exclusions, cleans up on timeout or interruption, and was measured without disrupting natural odds collection.
invalidation_conditions: Docker no longer uses cgroup v2 with the systemd driver or can no longer expose the physical backing device io.max.
The wrapper exclusion, containment, cleanup, or hard-limit read-back tests regress.
Bounded scans materially disrupt collection or host responsiveness in later representative evidence.
reopen_conditions: The wrapper, canonical host cgroup/Docker support, exclusion policy, live collection safety evidence, or draft-PR state changes after this closeout.
